key_findings: Sequential execution bottlenecks identify 0 validated parallelization opportunities.

agent_pruning_opportunities.title: Conditional Pruning or Pass-Through Bypass of invoice_validation_agent
agent_pruning_opportunities.observed_problem: Agent 'invoice_validation_agent' (Invoice Validation Auditor) performs repetitive secondary verification consuming an average of 1.43s per execution run. In non-deviating or low-risk cases, its output merely confirms upstream agent findings without altering the workflow decision path.
agent_pruning_opportunities.proposed_solution: Prune 'invoice_validation_agent' from the standard baseline execution path, converting it into a dynamic, conditional auditor triggered only when upstream ambiguity or high-risk deviations are detected.

expected_benefit.quality_impact: Negligible risk when paired with strict upstream confidence thresholds.

tradeoffs_and_risks.latency_tradeoff: Immediate latency reduction on baseline path.
tradeoffs_and_risks.token_cost_tradeoff: Direct reduction in prompt and completion tokens.

agent_consolidation_opportunities.title: Consolidate invoice_extraction_agent and invoice_validation_agent into Unified Agent
agent_consolidation_opportunities.observed_problem: Agents 'invoice_extraction_agent' and 'invoice_validation_agent' share tightly coupled operational scopes and require high intermediate data handoffs. Executing them as separate LLM agents introduces redundant context re-loading and inter-agent serialization latency (2.19s + 1.43s = 3.62s).
agent_consolidation_opportunities.proposed_solution: Merge 'invoice_extraction_agent' and 'invoice_validation_agent' into a single specialized agent with unified system instructions, eliminating the intermediate payload serialization and reducing prompt token re-transmission.

expected_benefit.quality_impact: Maintains full reasoning fidelity by handling extraction and categorization in a single coherent prompt.

tradeoffs_and_risks.latency_tradeoff: Significant latency reduction by eliminating one agent dispatch round-trip.
tradeoffs_and_risks.output_quality_risk: Low (joint extraction is well within standard LLM contextual capabilities).

model_selection_recommendations.title: Route invoice_extraction_agent to Smaller/Faster Model (requires validation)
model_selection_recommendations.observed_problem: Agent 'invoice_extraction_agent' performs structured syntactic extraction and text normalization. Assigning the high-parameter 120B model ('openai/gpt-oss-120b') introduces unnecessary latency (2.19s) and compute overhead for straightforward parsing tasks.
model_selection_recommendations.proposed_solution: Switch 'invoice_extraction_agent' to a compact specialized model (e.g., Llama-3.3-70B or Llama-3.1-8B) with structured schema output validation.

expected_benefit.quality_impact: High accuracy on standard schema parsing; edge case validation required.

tradeoffs_and_risks.latency_tradeoff: Substantial speedup on first-stage document intake.
tradeoffs_and_risks.token_cost_tradeoff: Over 60% compute cost reduction for this node.
tradeoffs_and_risks.output_quality_risk: Moderate (smaller models may miss subtle domain-specific abbreviations).

tool_optimization_opportunities.title: Deterministic Tool Result Caching for approval_recommendation_agent
tool_optimization_opportunities.observed_problem: Agent 'approval_recommendation_agent' repeatedly evaluates static compliance policies and reference definitions across runs without persistent local caching of deterministic lookup queries.
tool_optimization_opportunities.proposed_solution: Implement an in-memory TTL memoization cache for static policy lookups and clause reference matches.

expected_benefit.quality_impact: Zero risk for immutable policy reference lookups.

tradeoffs_and_risks.latency_tradeoff: Sub-millisecond retrieval for cached policy checks.

communication_optimization_opportunities.title: Streamline Intermediate Handoff Payloads to Field-Specific Deltas
communication_optimization_opportunities.observed_problem: Workflow passes full document and global context payloads across sequential agent boundaries (46 detected handoff edges). Intermediate agents receive unneeded upstream metadata, inflating prompt token consumption across every stage.
communication_optimization_opportunities.proposed_solution: Replace raw full-state serialization with typed, field-specific projection schemas. Each agent receives strictly its declared input requirements and emits only newly computed attributes.

expected_benefit.quality_impact: Reduces context dilution and LLM attention distraction.

tradeoffs_and_risks.token_cost_tradeoff: 20-25% reduction in cumulative workflow token volume.

additional_optimization_opportunities.title: Fast-Path Early Exit for Standard/Compliant Artifacts
additional_optimization_opportunities.observed_problem: The target workflow runs through all 8 stages sequentially regardless of input complexity or deviation status. Standard contracts or clean inputs that pass initial verification without issues still execute all downstream remediation and deep analysis loops, consuming ~31.1s.
additional_optimization_opportunities.proposed_solution: Introduce a fast-path conditional checkpoint: if zero high-risk ambiguities or compliance deviations are identified in early stages, bypass extensive multi-agent reconciliation and jump directly to final report generation.

expected_benefit.quality_impact: Maintains strict rigor by restricting fast-path to zero-deviation verified cases.

tradeoffs_and_risks.latency_tradeoff: Over 50% latency reduction on clean input distributions.
tradeoffs_and_risks.token_cost_tradeoff: Cuts token spend in half for routine standard cases.
